value.author: samMularczyk
value.layerInfo: A soft noisy ring of smoke.

radius: Where the ring sits, as a fraction of the short edge.
innerFade: Eats the ring from the inside, so the middle opens out instead of filling in.
detail: Angular frequency of the wisps - how many of them go round.
turbulence: A second, finer polar octave scrolling the other way, so the smoke churns rather than rotating as one piece.
color1: Colour where the noise is thin.
backColor: Colour behind the ring. Transparent by default.
evolution: Drives everything that moves, in degrees. Keyframe it, or drive it with a Frame behaviour - the rate is yours rather than tied to the comp clock.
loop: Makes the field return exactly to its start, so it can be cycled with no visible seam.
cycles: How many full revolutions of Evolution before it repeats. At 2 the field comes home at Evolution 720, not 360 - so a higher count travels further through the noise and gives more variation before the repeat.
